"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful HD 2.5D isometric pixel art graphics. Fixed camera angled diagonally from above, following the player. Detailed environments, smaller characters, smooth animations and rich fantasy colors. Optimize for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select Angels or Demons and choose one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and a character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: 9 equipment slots. Direct drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND FUSION: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village has blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never dropped, traded or fused. Gems are also earnable through gameplay. Free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All text in English.

DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PHASES:
Phase 1: Character creation, factions, classes, starting village, first region, movement, combat, monsters, inventory, equipment and basic quests.
Phase 2: Remaining regions, crafting, fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare for future real multiplayer, accounts and persistent data. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test features and fix errors. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a completely new, playable, mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called **AETHERIA** (2.5D isometric pixel-art, Canvas/vanilla JS) from scratch in `PlayGround/PlayGround`, covering character creation (gender, name, Angels/Demons factions, Warrior/Mage/Assassin classes, appearance), 8 regions, real-time combat, loot/equipment with a strict rarity/tier system, crafting/fusion, economy, quests, shop, and a two-phase roadmap — verified by running it in a real browser and fixing all errors found.

## Requirements
- HD 2.5D isometric pixel art, fixed diagonal camera following player, optimized for Android phones/tablets, all text in English.
- Character creation: male/female, unique name, Angels or Demons, 3 classes (Warrior melee / Mage ranged magic / Assassin fast crits), hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, 3 starting outfits, character preview; faction wings on characters.
- World: 8 regions — Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion, Tower of Eternity; towns Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket, Frosthaven.
- Gameplay: real-time combat, class skills upgradable to L10, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, XP/leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons, bosses; unique class weapons/armor.
- Loot: 9 equipment slots; direct drops Common 60% / Grey 25% / Green 10% / Blue 5%, always T3; Purple+ never drop directly.
- Fusion: 4 identical items → T3→T2, T2→T1, T1→next rarity T3; no random destruction. Legendary via rare materials/recipes/boss drops (boss stones have up to 3 bonuses). 4 Legendary→Mythic, 4 Mythic→Divine. Crit chance capped at 50%.
- Economy: gathering, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold/Gems, player marketplace, configurable prices; no repair system.
- Shop: costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings (wings ONLY from quest/shop — never dropped/traded/fused), Gems (also earnable in gameplay), optional premium; free-to-play.
- Mobile UI: virtual joystick, attack/skill buttons, interact, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory/equipment/quests/shop/profile panels.
- Phase 1 (creation, village, first region, combat, inventory, basic quests) and Phase 2 (remaining content) delivered; prepare architecture for future real multiplayer/accounts/persistence but never claim the local simulation is real multiplayer.
- Build must be a playable game, not a mockup; modular code; test and fix errors.
- Build request mode: no clarifying questions; make assumptions and note them at the end.
- Screenshots for verification: save small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide), read only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS + Canvas 2D, no external assets; all art procedurally generated pixel sprites (`js/sprites.js`).
- Modular files: `js/data.js` (pure data), `js/sprites.js`, `js/world.js` (procedural iso maps, prerendered LRU-cached), `js/game.js` (state/combat/loot/quests/economy/save), `js/ui.js` (renderer+HUD+panels+dialogs), `js/main.js` (boot/creation wizard/input/loop).
- Save = single localStorage document `aetheria_save_v1` shaped like a future server DB document; UI text explicitly notes "local demo, multiplayer-ready stubs".
- Tower of Eternity: dungeon with 2 mini-bosses + final boss, sealed gates requiring floor boss kills; requires Tower Key from Ashen boss (quest m9).
- Region gates require min level; teleporter charges configurable fees; towns are safe zones (monsters won't chase/aggro inside village radius).
- Verification approach: serve locally via `python3 -m http.server 8765`, drive Chromium via `playwright-core` (`require('/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core')`, executablePath `/usr/bin/chromium`, viewport 390x844, isMobile+hasTouch). Screenshots go to `/tmp/opencode/shots/*.jpg`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game implemented and playable: menu → loading → 4-step character creation (name/gender, faction, class+outfit, appearance with animated preview) → world.
- All 8 regions generate + prerender correctly (fixed critical prerender offset bug: iso X is negative for x<y; added `X0 = h*TW/2` shift, `wd.px0/py0`).
- Entities render (fixed NaN bug in `isoOf`'s stray `- -e.z * 0`). Player, NPCs with name labels, monsters, drops, projectiles, particles, damage floaters, target ring, boss arena rings all visible.
- Verified green (suite.js, 15/15 PASS, no page errors): MOVEMENT (WASD+joystick), COMBAT (auto-attack kills, XP, gold), SKILL, POTION, EQUIP (class restrictions), FUSION T3→T2, FUSION T1→Purple T3, LEGENDARY_CRAFT (stones grant bonuses to item), QUEST_TRACK, SHOP_MOUNT, MARKET, STORAGE, TRAVEL (level-gated), TOWER_LOCKED, SAVE_LOAD, CONTINUE.

- Towns complete: blacksmith(forge/fusion/skill training), merchant(potions/sell), quest NPCs, storage(60 slots), teleporter, market broker, gem boutique; all NPCs interactive via dialog.
- Quests m1 turn-in, faction wings quest (w1) turn-in granting wings, unlockable cosmetics (pet, fx trails), premium membership, skill upgrades all verified.

- `css/style.css`: full mobile UI theming (dark fantasy, HUD, panels, creation, dialogs).
- `js/data.js`: constants — rarities/tiers/drop shares, classes, items/fusion/craft, regions/monsters/kinds (`brute` kind added at end of MONSTER_KINDS), quests, ECON fees, SHOP catalogues.

- `js/ui.js`: renderer (sX/sY camera mapping using wd.px0/py0; `isoOf` fixed), HUD tick, toasts/floaters/pickups, all panels (inv/equip/char/quests/shop/craft/fusion/sell/storage/market/teleport/menu), NPC dialogs (`openDialog`), quest tracker.
- `js/main.js`: loading menu, 4-step creation wizard, joystick + keyboard input, rAF loop calling Game.tickPlayer/tickMonsters/UI.render/UI.tickHud, fade decay, autosave.

- `/tmp/opencode/suite2.js`: deep suite (drop shares, boss, turn-in, wings, premium, respawn, class restrict, skill up).

"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful HD 2.5D isometric pixel art graphics. Fixed camera angled diagonally from above, following the player. Detailed environments, smaller characters, smooth animations and rich fantasy colors. Optimize for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select Angels or Demons and choose one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and a character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: 9 equipment slots. Direct drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND FUSION: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village has blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never dropped, traded or fused. Gems are also earnable through gameplay. Free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All text in English.

DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PHASES:
Phase 1: Character creation, factions, classes, starting village, first region, movement, combat, monsters, inventory, equipment and basic quests.
Phase 2: Remaining regions, crafting, fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare for future real multiplayer, accounts and persistent data. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test features and fix errors. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)
